name: Better Buzz Coffee Escondido
notes: All 5 photos are printed menu boards for the same coffee shop, but photos 1, 2, 3 and 4/5 each show a different price set (photographed at different times, prices changed each time). Photos 4 and 5 are duplicate shots of the same indoor boards and were merged as one source. Used photos 4/5 as the primary source for the core drink/toast/sandwich/bowl items, and added items unique to photos 1-3 (Islander, Yogurt Bowl, Better Breakfast, Chili Crunch Breakfast, Sweet Heat Maple Croissant, Turkey & Brie Croissant) using their own listed prices. No modifiers/add-ons included.
